sections.shortTitle: Benazir Bhutto Shaheed University at Layari Karachi Amendment Act 2011
sections.description:
Short title and Commencement

ACT VII OF 2011
ACT VII OF 2011
BENAZIR BHUTTO
SHAHEED UNIVERSITY AT
LAYARI KARACHI
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 2011
An Act to amend the Benazir
Bhutto Shaheed
University at Lyari Karachi Act, 2009.
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part IV,
1st March, 2011]
No.PAS/Legis-B-04-2011, dated 24-2-2011.---The Benazir
Bhutto Shaheed University at Lyari
Karachi (Amendment) Bill, 2011 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of
Sindh on 24th January, 2011 and assented to by the
Governor of Sindh on 17th February, 2011 is hereby published as an Act of the Legislature
of Sindh.
Preamble.--Whereas it is expedient
to amend the Benazir
Bhutto Shaheed University
at Lyari Karachi Act, 2009, in the manner hereinafter
appearing;
It is hereby enacted as follows:--
1. Short title and Commencement. (1)
This Act may be called the Benazir Bhutto
Shaheed University at Lyari
Karachi (Amendment) Act, 2011.
(2) It shall come into force at once.
